instructions:
Below is an essay you revised once. Revise it so that it reads as if a US grade 8 student wrote it in class for a timed writing test. Keep the position it argues and keep it at about 242 words. The file must contain only the revised essay.

Essay:

Dear Principal,

I am writing to ask you not to make every student do community service. I think service is good and the school should encourage it, but it shouldn't be forced.

I have some friends who tutor little kids at the elementary school, and they like it. One of them told me the best part of her week is when a second grader finally sounds out a hard word. Another friend picks up trash by the creek behind our school and feels proud when he sees the difference. It works for them because they picked it themselves. They care about the kids and the creek, so they try hard.

If it was a requirement, that would change. Some of my friends work after school to help pay bills. Others watch their little siblings or have sports and homework. A quota would just be one more thing in a day that is already full. When people are mad about an assignment they just do the bare minimum, like sign a sheet and leave early. That doesn't help anybody, and it might make them not want to volunteer ever again.

A better idea is to make service easy and fun. The school could have sign-up fairs with groups, have projects on weekends and at lunch, and give shout-outs to volunteers at assemblies. More kids would join if they felt invited instead of forced.

Thank you for reading my letter.

Sincerely,
A concerned student
